title: 311chat — Non-emergency city help. Find your 311.
railText: FACT911 saves lives. 311 fixes the city.Call 911 for crime in progress, fire, medical emergency, or immediate danger — if unsure, call 911 and let the dispatcher decide. Use 311 (or your city's non-emergency portal) for potholes, streetlights, graffiti, trash, abandoned vehicles, noise, and other non-emergency city services.
